author: ghyls
body:
#### PR description:

Add a TrivialSerialisation plugin for `HGCRecHitCollection` (`std::vector<HGCRecHit>`).

TrivialSerialisation plugins allow CMSSW modules that do not know the type of a product at compile-time, to know the memory layout of this product, and thus to be able to copy it efficiently. This is particularly the case of the Sender/Receiver modules under `HeterogeneousCore/MPICore/` which we use in the context of remote GPU offloading to exchange collections between a local and a remote CMSSW process. The current approach for this collection involves serializing it through its ROOT dictionaries, sending the serialized buffer and deserializing it in the other end. The `TrivialSerialisation` plugin reduces this to just the send operation.


#### PR validation:

The plugin is successfully registered and the MPI modules in `HeterogeneousCore/MPICore/` use it. No unit tests have been added.



@fwyzard FYI
title: Add TrivialSerialisation support for std::vector<HGCRecHit>
